scenes.title: Super Senses
scenes.text: Animals sense things you cannot. Some hear, see, or smell the world in ways beyond human imagination.

scenes.title: Dolphins
scenes.text: Dolphins navigate by sound, bouncing clicks off objects to see shapes in complete darkness.

scenes.title: Bees
scenes.text: Bees see ultraviolet light, revealing bright secret landing patterns on flowers that are completely invisible to your eyes.

scenes.title: Snakes
scenes.text: Some snakes detect body heat in total darkness, hunting by sensing warmth instead of sight.

scenes.title: Octopus
scenes.text: An octopus has three hearts and eight arms that can think and act almost on their own.

scenes.title: Sloths
scenes.text: Sloths move so slowly that algae actually grows across their fur, turning each one into a tiny slow moving garden.

scenes.title: Tardigrade
scenes.text: Tardigrades can survive freezing, boiling, and even the vacuum of space, then wake up again.

scenes.title: Your Turn
scenes.text: Nature invented better technology than we did. Which animal superpower would you want for yourself?
